card.name: The word post before marketing or menopausal
card.fires_on: The word "post" when it begins a compound such as postmarketing or postmenopausal, mostly right after "In", "been" or "on" in label safety text.

modes.label: Postmarketing
modes.description: "post" starting "postmarketing" in adverse-reaction or experience sections.

modes.label: Postmenopausal
modes.description: "post" starting "postmenopausal" when describing a patient group.
